headline: DKI Jakarta Awaits Rp3 Trillion Underpayment of DBH from the Finance Minister
summary: Jakarta's provincial government is waiting for a finance ministry regulation to disburse a Rp3 trillion shortfall in revenue-sharing funds. It is also preparing loans as an alternative for infrastructure funding.
why: Regional revenue-sharing transfers from the central government fund local budgets and infrastructure spending in Indonesia.
original_headline: DKI Jakarta Tunggu Rp3 Triliun Kurang Bayar DBH dari Menkeu
